custom_expected: Clock In and Clock Out both succeed. Even a user with no permissions can still track their time — universal clock-in is intentionally not role-gated (S23-E1 edge case).
custom_preconds: Test user assigned to 'only one Permission' custom role (created in the 'Custom role with ALL permissions OFF except for one'
custom_steps:
1. Log in as test user.
  2. Locate the universal clock in/out control.
  3. Click Clock In.
  4. Click Clock Out.
  5. As Administrator, verify the timestamped entries appear in the user's timesheet.
title: Universal clock in/out works even for users with ALL permissions OFF (Only one permission assigned)
